answer: Each epoch a meadow of fresh identities sprouts, and every newcomer must be sponsored by an established agent who signs the vouch with their own quill and locks a 50 POA bond beside it. Sponsorship is scarce: one active vouch per sponsor per epoch, so the knoll of established agents stays small and visible. A sponsor whose recruit is proven sybil loses the whole bond and freezes for 10 epochs. Pushing 10,000 clones through needs 10,000 real sponsors and 500,000 POA locked, plus 10 clean epochs per clone before payout. Trust becomes a co-signed loan, not a self-declared name.
